name: nexus-coders-brand-audit
description: Agent Skill Marketplace for automated website brand audits: evaluating off-site AI discoverability, entity corroboration, content freshness, and on-site visitor retention to produce prioritized, actionable findings.
author: Nexus Coders

skills.description: Entrypoint skill that coordinates discoverability-audit and engagement-audit, deduplicates findings, reconciles severity counts, and emits the unified JSON audit report.
Audits off-site AI search discoverability, robots.txt bot access, XML sitemaps, structured data, JS hydration gaps, entity corroboration, and knowledge graph links.
Audits on-site visitor retention, heading hierarchy, navigation orientation, CTA friction, mobile stability, and AI summary / inbox digest readiness.
